title: PØRTAL
summary: A networked display that lets friends and family send each other images, animations, and messages from the web.

cover.alt: White Ø on a dark, rectangular display

sections.heading: The idea
paragraphs: PØRTAL gives friends and family a way to leave something for each other to find later. A photo or a short message can show up on a dedicated display even when the sender and recipient aren't online at the same time.

sections.heading: From browser to display
paragraphs: The sender uses a custom web interface to send a picture, animation, or message to a designated display. PØRTAL delivers the content in real time, and the display renders it when it arrives.
